title: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/w/d)- Certil
description:
Du baust LLM-Anwendungen, die im Unternehmensalltag funktionieren, nicht nur in der Demo. Und Du bleibst dran, bis sie beim Kunden stabil laufen.
Zwischen einer beeindruckenden KI-Demo und einer Anwendung im Unternehmensalltag liegt viel Arbeit. Genau dort setzt certil an: Wir entwickeln eine Plattform, mit der Unternehmen KI-gestützte und agentische Anwendungen kontrolliert einsetzen können. Quellen, Rechenwege und menschliche Entscheidungen werden nachvollziehbar. Ergebnisse lassen sich nachrechnen, und Menschen prüfen sie und entscheiden offene Fragen verantwortlich.
Bei certil heißt der Bereich, der aus Strategie konkrete Use Cases beim Kunden macht, Forward Engineering . Er umfasst die ganze Kette: Use Case, Konzept, Prototyp, erstes Produkt und Betrieb, gemessen auf jeder Stufe. Der erste Use Case läuft, weitere folgen. Als Forward Deployed Engineer übernimmst Du zuerst Bau und Einführung beim Kunden und betreust mittelfristig ganze Use Cases eigenverantwortlich.
Aufgaben
Was Du bei uns machst
Use Cases zuschneiden: Gemeinsam mit dem Kunden echte Fälle von Hand durchrechnen und messen, ob sich der Use Case lohnt

Expertenwissen übersetzen: Die Arbeitsweise von Fachexpert:innen in prüfbare Schritte zerlegen: Dokumente lesen, rechnen, entscheiden

Selbst bauen: Vom Prototyp zum ersten produktiven Stand, mit Coding Agents und testgetrieben

Einführen und stabilisieren: Den Use Case beim Kunden einführen und so weit stabilisieren, dass manuelle Kontrollschritte wegfallen

Zurückspielen: Wiederverwendbare Bausteine an unser Plattform-Team geben, damit der nächste Use Case schneller geht

Nicht passend für Dich, wenn …
Du in den letzten zwei Jahren nicht mehr selbst programmiert hast, etwa weil Du in einer reinen Architektur-, Management- oder Beraterrolle warst,

Deine LLM-Erfahrung aus Demos oder Hackathons stammt und nie bei echten Nutzer:innen im Einsatz war,

Du bisher nur nach Ticket umgesetzt hast, ohne direkten Kontakt zu Kunden oder Fachabteilungen,

Du am liebsten bei Demo, Proof of Concept oder Konzept aufhörst und den Rest an andere übergibst.

Qualifikation
Was Du mitbringst
Mehrere Jahre Softwareentwicklung, sicher in Python und TypeScript, und Du programmierst aktuell selbst

Du hast LLM-Anwendungen über den Prototyp hinaus gebracht, mit gemessener Qualität, z. B. in Extraktion, Klassifikation oder Evaluation

Coding Agents wie Claude Code, Cursor oder Codex gehören zu Deinem Arbeitsalltag

Du hast direkt mit Kunden oder Fachabteilungen gearbeitet und Anforderungen selbst erhoben

Deutsch fließend, Englisch sicher

Ein Plus, wenn Du …
Branchenwissen in Fertigung, Einkauf, Kalkulation oder Controlling mitbringst

Erfahrung mit Workflow-Orchestrierung und Human-in-the-Loop-Prozessen hast

schon in prüfpflichtigen Umgebungen gearbeitet hast, etwa mit Audit, Compliance oder Revision

Was wir Dir bieten
Eine Kategorie, die gerade entsteht: KI, deren Arbeit man verantworten kann. Mit den ersten Use Cases prägst Du sie mit

Bauen und einführen in einer Rolle: vom Zuschnitt bis zum stabilen Betrieb, ohne Übergaben

Echte Kundenprojekte statt Demos: Die Wirkung beim Kunden wird gemessen

Jeder Use Case zählt doppelt: Er hinterlässt Bausteine, die den nächsten schneller machen

Aktuelle Modelle, Coding Agents und Raum zum Experimentieren als Standard

Ein Team, das technisch auf Augenhöhe diskutiert, mit direktem Draht zum Gründungsteam

Voll-remote möglich ; Teamtage und Kundenworkshops vor Ort, üblicherweise 2–4 Tage im Monat im DACH-Raum

Bewerbung: Zeig uns, was Du gebaut hast!
Schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte kurz folgende Frage:
Dein Use Case im Betrieb (3–5 Sätze): Beschreib eine LLM-Anwendung, die Du bei Nutzer:innen in den Betrieb gebracht hast. Was hat sie gelöst, welchen Teil hast Du selbst gebaut, wie hast Du die Qualität gemessen, und wer hat nach dem Go-live die Verantwortung für das Ergebnis getragen?
Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich und Deine Projekte kennenzulernen!

We're focused entirely on eCommerce, and our goal is simple: to be one of the best eCommerce tech teams in the world.

About the Role
What you’ll do
Lead front-end development for top-tier eCommerce projects and be the person the client talks to: weekly calls, agreeing on priorities, explaining your choices

Work closely with a PM who keeps the project organized, so you can focus on hands-on work. Collaborate with designers and other devs to turn ideas into high-performing storefronts

Write clean, reliable code that is ready for production

Make key technical and architectural decisions, and explain why you made them

Own the whole project, not just your own tasks: scope, risks, delivery and the result for the client

Continuously push for better engineering practices and scalable solutions

Contribute to internal standards, tooling, and AI-assisted workflows, and help the team find where AI really saves time

Mentor other developers and promote best practices

Who you are and what we are looking for
A senior engineer with 5+ years in JavaScript/TypeScript, ideally React / Next.js / React-Router or a similar framework

You have worked with clients from the outside, not as part of their team (agency, consultancy, freelance). This is a must

You’ve led production projects or small teams before. You know how to ship

You value pragmatic engineering. You focus on what works and scales, not over-engineering

You care about both the craft and the outcome: elegant solutions that drive real business results, with an eye for polish, UX, and performance

You enjoy working in small, dedicated teams and take ownership of the whole project, not just your task

You use AI tools every day and know where they help and where they don’t

Comfortable managing multiple shifting priorities with support from PM and engineering managers

Strong communication: you can discuss trade-offs with clients and teammates. Fluent English (for client work) and at least B2 Polish

Bonus: experience with headless commerce (Shopify, Commerce Layer, etc.)

What it’s really like to work here
At Commerce-UI, we trust each other’s judgment and take pride in our craft. Everyone here owns their work, not because someone expects it, but because we care about what we build and who we build it with.
Owning a project means knowing it end to end and being the partner the client calls when something matters. You’re not part of their team and you don’t just take tickets. If you’ve only worked inside a client’s organisation, it can be a big step, and we’d rather say so upfront.
You won’t carry it alone: a project manager keeps planning, priorities and client logistics in order, so you can stay hands-on with the code.
We take AI seriously and use it on purpose. It already saves us time, and our last hackathon was all about it.
We work fast, with real autonomy from day one, no layers of management or rigid playbooks, and a lot of trust that everyone knows what they’re doing. If that sounds like you, you’ll feel right at home.

Why you’ll love working here
Small, senior, passionate team - no bureaucracy, real impact

Work on ambitious, design-led projects for global brands

Freedom to shape how we build things

Competitive pay and flexible, remote-friendly culture

Our Tech stack
Shopify Hydrogen (React-Router 7/Remix) or Next.js

Oxygen, Vercel, Cloudlfare

Shopify Liquid/Online Store 2.0

Typescript (always)

CSS, Sass, CSS Modules, Stitches, Vanilla extract

Toolkit
Cursor, Webstorm

ChatGPT

Google Workspace

Jira

Notion

Loom

Team
Most of the time, you’ll collaborate closely with:
Tomek and Kuba - Engineering Managers

Robert - Head of Project Management

Michał - Co-Founder & CTO

Szymon - Co-Founder

How our hiring process looks like?
Application → send us your CV and any link/portfolio that show your craft. We review every application and always get back to you - regardless of the outcome.

Discovery call → this is short (30 minutes) mutual check-in - we want to understand your expectations and share ours. We will talk in Polish, and English.

Task → a short focused task based on the kind of work we actually do. ~2 hours with clear instructions. We respect your time.

Tech call → a deep dive into how you think and solve problems. You’ll chat with Kuba or Tom (our Engineering Managers) - no trick questions, just real talk about tech and delivery.

Offer → if it’s a match, we’ll schedule a short call (20-30 minutes) to go over the details and next steps. If we don’t move forward we’ll do our best to give you thoughtful feedback.

Netguru is a trusted partner in digital commerce. The company helps leading brands modernize B2B solutions, marketplaces, and retail ecosystems. A certified B Corporation®, Netguru is trusted by major brands including IKEA, VW, OLX, Delivery Hero, Żabka, Wolt, Careem, and Vinted.

How freelancing works at Netguru?
As a Netguru freelancer , you can choose what works well for you. You decide when, where, and how you work on projects and tasks.
We match you with work that fits your skills. Plus, you have access to various opportunities across different industries and companies. That means you will not only gain more experience, but also develop various skills.
But there's more. Netguru freelancers can benefit from full-time collaboration and really be a part of the team.
So, are you ready to make an impact? Join Netguru, and let's build beautiful software together.

We are looking for a Senior Fullstack Engineer
Start date : asap
Duration: around 3 months
Full-time
100% remote
Working hours: CET
Hourly rate : up to 41€/h

Tasks & responsibilities:
Take full ownership of internal grading tooling.
Build and maintain supporting systems centered around inventory and order flows on live production systems.
Deliver high-impact features contributing directly to core business roadmaps.
Requirements
Core Backend: Node.js, TypeScript, Python.
Database & Architecture: PostgreSQL, Event-driven architectures (Kafka), Microservices.
DevOps / Infrastructure: Terraform, Kubernetes.
Frontend: JavaScript (Basic frontend capabilities required for internal tools).

Java/Spring Boot, Avro schemas, Apollo codegen, Jest/React Testing Library, webpack/Module Federation, Ant Design migrations. Experience with AI coding agents is a plus, not a requirement.
Benefits
In return, we offer:
100% remote, flexible work.
Work with an experienced team of developers and continuous development of your hard and soft skills.
Dev-friendly processes such as Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery, Code Review and bug bashes.
What will happen next?
We would like to know you better, so we will invite you for a meeting with our recruiter.
Next, you'll be invited to an interview and pair programming with one of our Developers.
If everything goes well, you will meet the client at the final interview.

Looking for a full-time job? Check out our Career Page and find out more about our open recruitment processes.
If you need any disability-related adaptation at any step of the recruitment process – simply let the recruiter know! We'd be happy to help.

description:
Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

 

Why Join Coalition Technologies?

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade

Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month

Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance

Subsidized gym memberships

Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members

International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members

Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs

Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards

Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

 

Office Assistant Responsibilities

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

Answering phones and emails

Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records

Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members

Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members
